qualification: CONDITIONAL, not final FOC threshold or transistor macromodel
source: TLV6700 datasheet VIT+/VIT− over temperature, 5.23k hypothetical 0.1% and 25ppm/C both divider arms, 60C component excursion, input bias ±25nA conservatively compared

ground_assumption.warning: 40mV assumes DC current only; shunt tolerance, dynamics and wiring excluded

ideal_release.condition: zero regen, ideal full discharge through 0.779Ω; not actual battery current or released switch timing

limits: 41V FOC threshold is an engineering hypothetical; compare actual earliest threshold and local voltage difference.
29us TLV6700 timing at 10mV overdrive is typical and input equivalent ~1V BUS; cannot use as worst-case at threshold.
Threshold, propagation, inactive BJT saturation, filtering, startup, source OR, power loss and 3m stopping still require physical qualification.
Output gate and switch idealized, no temperature/motor torque/wire EMI or PCB verification.
